text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, they've reached the final straight!! 
Every Umamusume is launching into their 
final sprint!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahh!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Let's settle this, Ai-san...!! Right 
here, right now, I'm coming right at ya!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(You're not the only one who gets to 
define this era!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (The "Queen" is the star of the show!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac surges ahead!! She takes the 
lead!!! It's Lucky Lilac!! This is the 
running of a true "Queen"!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Lucky Lilac crosses the line!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Defying a field of top contenders!! The 
"Queen" blooming in full glory in Tokyo!! 
It's Lucky Lilac!!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I did it………… I really…………――

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I... won... this Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! Lucky Lilac was incredible!! A 
complete victory over Almond Eye!! That 
was a historic race~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Man, Almond Eye and Lucky Lilac are really 
bringing the heat...! They're the ultimate 
rivals, aren't they...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Two tempests that shake the era. Yet 
their fierce clash brings vibrant color to 
the world——"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That was a truly magnificent race, Orfe. 
It's been a long time since my heart raced 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ………………Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us return, Sister. Please prepare 
some tea and sweets."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Shall I brew something special 
today?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.
Lala!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ai-san—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: First off, thank you!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh— Th-Thank you...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks to you, I finally realized just 
how small I had made myself become."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I intended to give it everything I had 
today. I wanted to run the absolute best 
race I possibly could!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to push beyond all limits just 
to win, even if it meant giving it 
everything I had! ...And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: And yet, Lala surpassed it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
As if crying out that there are no limits. 
Faster, stronger than anyone else, 
crossing the finish line...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to that, I realized. I can still 
keep growing, and break right through my 
limits!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: And... thank you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! Next time, I'm going to 
push past my limits and claim victory over 
you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: So, look forward to that time!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(What's that supposed to mean? I never 
expected Ai-san to talk about reaching her 
limits or anything like that.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I always thought you were an Umamusume 
who had nothing to do with stuff like 
that, but... Guess Ai-san has her own 
struggles, too.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...In that sense, maybe I actually 
managed to play the straight man to Ai-san 
today.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(“There's no such thing as limits for us,” 
she said.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...? Lala, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Almond Eye-san, mark my words.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times you break past 
your limits and grow stronger, I'll face 
you down every single time and ask, "Is 
that really the strongest you've got?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: After all, I'm the "Queen" of tsukkomi.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Aha, what's that? ............ But—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I want to challenge you as many 
times as it takes, my "Queen." I want to 
beat you again and again, Lala!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Because we're rivals! Right?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"We are rivals. And we're the stars... who 
will brighten up the racing world from 
here on."
—Afterward, at the winner's interview.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, first of all, Lucky Lilac, could 
we get a few words from you about how 
you're feeling right now?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...The road leading up to this point was 
filled with many hardships.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
However, as a "Queen," I believed in my 
own breakthrough, overcame the hurdles, 
and fearlessly challenged the era's 
strongest. That is why I believe I was 
able to grasp today's glory.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
From here on, please look forward to my 
fearless, resolute running— becoming of a 
true "Queen."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! As expected of Lucky Lilac, her 
words carry such poise...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Right? Right? I've been visualizin' being 
"Queen" like crazy! Somethin' like this is 
a piece of cake!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next we'd like to ask the Trainer 
a few questions! Please, share your 
thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, you look sharp and ready too, 
Trainer! This is the critical moment!)

Even without words, I can tell. Lucky 
Lilac is counting on me to nail it with 
absolute perfection...!

"I'll nail it, without fail. As her 
partner, I'll deliver a comment that's 
smart, yet overflowing with raw 
passion――――!!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Kaaah——

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...You stumbled over your words, didn't 
you~? You're way too nervous, hohoho.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(That was so close!!!!! I almost hit 'em 
with a full-on comeback retort!!! Pulling 
that off with a straight face is totally 
cheating!!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, a rare straight-man retort just 
burst out of Lucky Lilac-san.
choice_data_list:
I'm always zoning out, so you really save 
me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Acting the fool? Really now. This isn't a 
comedy routine, you know.

text_block_list.name: Laughter
text_block_list.text: (Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Oh no! I gave a gentle straight-man 
comeback out of habit again!! And why did 
that actually get a few chuckles?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (......Well, even so—)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, the two of you make such a 
well-coordinated duo!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Well, as long as they think we're close 
friends, that's fine by me.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Even after that, they occasionally 
engaged in witty banter like a comedy duo, 
revealing the undeniable bond between 
them"......

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it literally says "Comedy Duo" right 
there!
choice_data_list:
Sorry, Luck! It wasn't supposed to be like 
this—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's fine! I was kinda jumping in 
with some low-key comebacks here and there 
myself."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I suppose it goes both ways... It 
must've just become second nature to us 
over all the time we've spent together up 
until today."
choice_data_list:
Wearing mostly white clothes came back to 
bite me...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm not talkin' about stains standing 
out!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I mean, that's what I'm talkin' about!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep doing things our own way from 
here on out... I'll be countin' on ya."

The days of taking on challenges with my 
partner, Lucky Lilac, are far from over—
